reference: Dummy bloodwork marker library for local-only logging; replace with reviewed lab references before production.
notes: Informational display scaffold only; not medical advice.
Reference ranges vary by lab, method, age, sex, medication status, and clinical context.
Bloodwork logs are intended to remain local-only and excluded from server sync/share dashboards.

markerGroups.label: Hormones
markerGroups.summary: Markers commonly reviewed in HRT, TRT, fertility, and endocrine contexts.

markerGroups.label: Lipids
markerGroups.summary: Cholesterol and triglyceride markers often trended during diet, training, or medication changes.

markerGroups.label: Metabolic
markerGroups.summary: Glucose and liver/kidney-adjacent markers used as general health context.

markerGroups.label: Thyroid
markerGroups.summary: Thyroid markers whose interpretation depends heavily on symptoms and clinical context.

markerGroups.label: Inflammation
markerGroups.summary: Broad inflammation markers that can be transiently affected by illness, injury, and training.

markers.label: Total testosterone
markers.summary: Total circulating testosterone marker; context differs substantially by sex, age, HRT/TRT use, and lab method.

markers.label: Estradiol
markers.summary: Estradiol marker used in many hormone contexts; ranges are cycle-, therapy-, and assay-dependent.

markers.label: SHBG
markers.summary: Sex hormone-binding globulin; often reviewed alongside testosterone and estradiol.

markers.label: LDL-C
markers.summary: Low-density lipoprotein cholesterol marker; risk interpretation depends on broader clinical context.

markers.label: HDL-C
markers.summary: High-density lipoprotein cholesterol marker; displayed as a lab value, not a risk diagnosis.

markers.label: Triglycerides
markers.summary: Blood lipid marker that can vary with fasting status, alcohol, diet, illness, and lab timing.

markers.label: Fasting glucose
markers.summary: Fasting glucose value; display should preserve fasting/non-fasting context in notes.

markers.label: HbA1c
markers.summary: Approximate longer-term glucose marker; interpretation depends on clinical context and lab method.

markers.label: ALT
markers.summary: Alanine aminotransferase marker; can be affected by training, alcohol, medications, and liver context.

markers.label: TSH
markers.summary: Thyroid-stimulating hormone; trend display should avoid diagnosis without clinician context.

markers.label: Free T4
markers.summary: Free thyroxine marker commonly reviewed with TSH.

markers.label: hs-CRP
markers.summary: High-sensitivity C-reactive protein; can be transiently changed by illness, injury, and hard training.
